test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The idea was to __delivered governmental services__ at the citizen’s doorstep.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. (deliver government services)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb form 'delivered' is incorrect in the context. Instead, the base form 'deliver' should be used. Also, 'governmental' can be more commonly expressed as 'government'.
 
• Therefore the corrected sentence should read, "The idea was to deliver government services at the citizen's doorstep."
 
• Therefore, Option 4 (deliver government services) is the correction for the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: "The idea was to deliver government services at the citizen's doorstep."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "delivering government serviced" - This contains a spelling error ('serviced' instead of 'services') and doesn't fit the verb tense context.
 
• "delivers governmental servicing" - The tense is incorrect because 'was' requires the infinitive verb form (to deliver), and 'servicing' doesn't fit the context.
